scope: PR_10G multi-position Zigzag commercial-order checks. Includes one explicit Excel scratch formula at Main!ZZ100 on temporary copies only; the original workbook has no order-total cell/formula asserted.
method: Both original source XLSM files were copied to temporary files and recalculated with Excel 16 CalculateFullRebuild. Every engine monetary/quantity calculation uses exact rationals. EXACT compares exact rationals to captured IEEE-754 bits. DISPLAY_MATCH compares by captured Excel NumberFormat and does not assert unrounded equality. NUMERICALLY_EQUIVALENT means exact IEEE-754 bit equality after the engine rational is rounded once to binary64 for comparison. No epsilon is used. Main!ZZ100 = S11*Z11+S12*Z12 was added only to temporary workbooks to independently evaluate the position-price aggregation; it is not a source formula.
